review_notes: 题面给出更新排序、全部非排除标记、净额定容量和减量需求；从最老机组连续选择至首次超过600 MW得到A、B、C，排序补丁与法规原文和唯一求解结果闭合。
危险品列车、沿线辖区、政府授权及可能参与响应或调查均已明确；向三个外部响应单位提供实时电子编组信息与PHMSA原文直接对应。
决策日已越过现金与回购延期合规日；非关联对冲基金回购和注册经纪交易商现券交易属于合格交易，州政府回购和自然人现券交易落入明示排除，清算动作闭合。
潜在受影响系统影响在工作日0识别且适用已生效委员会资费；通知不晚于10日、回复距通知不晚于20日的两条补丁与FERC原文逐项对应。
设施、门槛、通航水域重大损害与豁免分支均已闭合；修订补丁仅要求至少一种可在白班外运行的人员或自动检测程序，没有再把计划内容规则强化成每个起点分别安装设备。
联邦陆上输油管道适用性、复杂度和输送产品均明确；运行监控、历史数据、消息报警回溯及按CSA Z662设计的泄漏检测四项必选与OPR第37条闭合。
零售与专业客户排除了仅合格对手方分支；仅含make-whole条款的晨星债和松林债满足债券豁免，而另含可转换或利率衍生条款者被正确排除。
IOTA强制参与者已进入PY2，来源明确此时同时存在向医院付款、中性及医院向CMS付款可能；本地政策要求覆盖全部方向，因此综合双向账户为唯一合规候选。
周末可用候选只剩裕廊与榜鹅；裕廊的零售牌照、主管药剂师及HSA电子药房评估均闭合，榜鹅同时缺主管药剂师和专项评估，排除后最优点可复现。
爱尔兰批发授权持有人对收货和发货两类交易均须保留可供检查记录至少五年；两个档案激活变量及各五年下界与来源直接对应。
自营交易和代客户提交交易与规则的直接、间接参与者保证金类别一一对应；分别固定到自营与客户账户完整落实分离持有要求。
大型品牌所有者为2027相关年度申请，法定截止日为前一年10月1日；三个候选中仅9月30日及时，顾问联结和成本均由题面给出。
责任企业明确选择显著能耗区域路径，五区构成完整100%分区；95%覆盖约束使熔炼、压缩空气和热处理成为最小合规组合。
四项申请均正确提交且收件顺序明确；8百万预算下依次处理河湾3、山丘4后仅余1，林地2与海港5均不能授予，当前顺序补丁与预算流程得到河湾加山丘。
未持证司机仅可在持有效证书人员在场直接监督下作业；全程监督事实、条件联结和司机互斥选择闭合，林杰加赵敏为合规最优。
单一一级承运人接入、指标服务失败、无积极抗辩、可行性及无不当损害均已逐项闭合；§1145.6使用will prescribe，固定签发命令而非延后正确。
两个项目均为OPR第55条列举项目且间隔从刚完成审计起算；分别施加三年最大间隔后，资源平滑目标得到两个三年。

相关关键资产起算日使六个月过渡期在决策日前届满，工程评估又闭合合理可行限定；运行环境、重大风险、处置、影响缓解、审查和持续更新六项均由第9条直接支持。

The public emergency determination, customer relationship, durations and non-overlap conditions exactly support hospital_first=1 and the big-M order rows; all objective coefficients and optimal actions reproduce.

Federal jurisdiction, the press hazard and excluded exception branches are public, so service_press implies isolate_press without hidden inputs; capacity, values and costs align and both optimal faces reproduce.

The public task now fixes the short one-peak low-level plan, the unfinished prior event, last block F, ordinary F/G/H sequence and protected hospital status; forcing G is therefore reconstructible without importing the variable-rota branch, and the solver reproduces disjoint optimal actions.

PASS: the Federal Reserve rule directly limits the buffer to unencumbered cash, HQLA or other assets demonstrated to satisfy the stated tests, and defines the bounded central-bank or GSE pledge route. Public encumbrance and failed-test facts exactly exclude the company bond and ordinarily pledged agency asset; capital, buffer need, domains and objectives align.

PASS: ESMA requires an appropriately transparent charging structure but expressly makes opacity and duplicated-cost checks non-exhaustive. The repaired task supplies a third independently adequate holistic method and states that none of the three reviews has been done, so the single at-least-one assessment gate preserves the alternative-means branch rather than hardening examples into exhaustive duties; objectives and optimal actions reproduce.

PASS: Minnesota section 144G.70 directly triggers RN reassessment when a covered resident's needs change and requires service-plan revision when needed. Chen's covered service, changed mobility, RN role and affirmative revision finding are public, so reassessment and its revision successor are fully grounded; nurse capacity and all values reproduce.

PASS: the repaired official excerpt now contains one complete sentence requiring an independent entity's annual secret-shopper surveys both to test appointment-wait compliance and to validate provider-directory accuracy. The public task fixes the applicable post-July-2028 rating period, the two designated service classes, independent execution and absent current work. Both surveys and the single directory-validation action are therefore supported, while the former unsupported remedy-plan branch has been removed; the solver reproduces disjoint optimal actions.

PASS: NEA directly requires an obligated company to report specified packaging imported or used in Singapore with supporting documents. The public task exhaustively identifies PET bottles and paper cartons as its only packaging streams, states the turnover and regulated-goods predicates, and says the supporting basis is absent; the two reporting equalities and supporting-document equality are fully reconstructible, and the solver reproduces disjoint optimal actions.

PASS: WHO guidance directly states that quantity and quality received must correspond to the order. The testing site expressly incorporated that guidance into a binding written receiving policy, both lots have valid orders and neither check is complete; all four receipt-to-check links therefore follow without treating WHO guidance as universal law, and the objective/action sets reproduce.

PASS: OSHA 1910.23(c)(3) directly includes employee, tool, equipment and material loads in maximum intended load. The public task gives every load component, ladder rating and simultaneous shared-ladder fact, yielding exactly the 120/70 versus 100/160 capacity row; ladder choice, values, costs and both optimal faces reproduce.

PASS: HSE's current PUWER guidance directly requires employer-provided work equipment to remain efficient, operational and in good repair. The public pre-shift inspection identifies an unrepaired hydraulic leak and guard misalignment, so each same-shift operation-to-repair link is grounded; the one-maintenance capacity and all objective terms align and reproduce.

PASS: Wisconsin section 195.45 directly prohibits water common-carrier operation outside a certificate based on public-interest and convenience-and-necessity findings. Public route-specific certificate, finding and no-exception facts make Lake ineligible while Green Bay remains eligible; route capacity, values and disjoint optimal actions reproduce.

PASS: Maine section 555 directly bars a Bureau motor-carrier safety rule from taking effect until at least five days after filing and provides the immediate-threat emergency route. The decision-maker is now the state safety authority selecting its own filed versions; July 30 lacks the emergency finding, July 27 has elapsed five days, and the same-day version alone has the written emergency finding. Excluding only July 30 is supported and both optimal faces reproduce.

PASS: ESOS regulation 26 directly requires audit coverage of identified significant-consumption areas and permits multiple area audits; one unified total-consumption audit also covers both named areas. The relevant-undertaking, significant-area, no-prior-coverage, verifiable-data and no-alternative-path facts are public, and the two coverage rows, capacities and objectives reproduce.

PASS: EASA's in-force FAQ directly answers that the 168-hour interval can be extended only through a formal ORO.FTL.235(d) amendment. The public task closes the applicable FTL scheme, approved-scheme and no-amendment facts, so the 176-hour choice is excluded without hidden discretion; choice, values and optimal actions reproduce.

PASS: the FCC excerpt now preserves the per-PSAP certification structure and the completed-diversity, comparable-alternative and remediation-with-anticipated-completion-date branches. The public task models completed diversity and a fully specified remediation certification package separately for each served PSAP, and explicitly closes alternative-measure and inapplicability facts. Each equality therefore preserves the two locally available FCC routes instead of forcing completed construction; costs, base semantics and disjoint optimal actions reproduce.

PASS: California Government Code 53122 directly requires covered 911-access providers to notify within 60 minutes of discovering a community-isolation outage. The public 14:00 discovery, qualifying 911 interruption, provider and no-exception facts establish the trigger while leaving the 60-minute rule to search; 14:45 remains eligible and 15:15 is correctly excluded, with both optima reproduced.
